messages:
joan-cs: Heads-up: Beaconly (acct beacon-77) seeing steady 429s from embeddings during k8s HPA scale-up. Started when pods jumped 2->20 for a canary import.
mike-dev: can you share init code and token flow?
joan-cs: node-sdk v1.2.0; each pod spawns 10 workers and creates a client per worker. sidecar issues short-lived JWTs; all pods call it at startup. snippet:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1', keepAlive: false, maxParallelInit: 20 });
await client.prefetch();
```
logs: `WARN embeddings 429 route=/v1/embeddings tenant=beacon-77 retry_after=2s`.
talia-sre: sounds like synchronized preflight + disabled keepAlive -> many short connections and token validation spikes. Mitigations: enable keepAlive, share client per pod, splay token TTLs, reduce maxParallelInit, add backoff+jitter on 429.
joan-cs: customer made changes: shared client per pod, turned on keepAlive, added token TTL splay and reduced prefetch.
mike-dev: quick follow-up: enable tenant preflight coalescing for 12h and temporary onboarding rate bump. I'll open an infra ticket.
quota-bot: RW-TICKET-13021 opened and assigned to infra-onboard.
talia-sre: I'll draft a k8s onboarding runbook recommending pod-level client reuse, staggered readiness, and HPA warmup annotations.
joan-cs: after changes, 10-min test showed 429s dropped drastically. Customer requested a short note for onboarding guide. Closing after infra confirms temporary window flip. :thumbsup:
